title: Sobolev Gradient Ascent for Optimal Transport: Barycenter Optimization and Convergence Analysis
tldr_zh: 无约束凹对偶+Sobolev梯度上升算精确barycenter，免c-concave投影，O(T^{-1/2})收敛，每步O(mn log n)
tldr_en: Constraint-free concave dual with Sobolev gradient ascent computes exact barycenter without c-concave projection, O(T^{-1/2}) rate

key_numbers.number: SGA time 202-700s vs WDHA 498-1064s vs CWB 1145-2520s vs DSB 3643-5192s
SGA barycenter value 1.645-5.964 (×10^3), lowest in all 12 weight settings
WDHA diverges in 3D setting, SGA does not
